授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Molecular cell biology has made remarkable progress in recent years.
The creation of new modality and biotechnology based on the knowledge of molecular cell biology has increased one after another.
This course focuses on basic molecular cell biology to deepen your understanding of advanced biotechnology.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Cell signaling pathway, Immnology, Development, Cell cycle
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: There are no specific conditions to take this course, but basic knowledge related with biotechnology, bioprocess engineering, biochemistry and molecular biology is desirable.

授業科目の実施方法について.教授・学習法: 一方向性の知識伝達型の教授・学習法

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他:
